definition.title: Under the Watchers
definition.briefing: Liora searches the watcher archive for the missing grove wards. Patrols face along their routes. Walk behind them, collect the ward record, and return to the southern glade; Veil Doubles can draw a watcher away.
definition.successText: The record names a living seed in the eastern grove. Liora sends Oren to retrieve it before the watch burns the forest.
definition.failureText: The watchers raise a second alarm or catch Liora. Begin again from the southern glade.

objectives.text: Reach the marked archive at (28, 7) without two alarms.
Return Liora Ashwing to (6, 29) with the archive. Move around guard sight cones; fighting is optional.

definition.title: The Living Seed
definition.briefing: Tender Oren must return from the eastern nursery to the Elderheart. Escort him around the burned ridge. Keep the Mothbows behind Thornblades when the watcher groups arrive.
definition.successText: Oren returns with the seed. Liora chooses whether to defend the old grove or use its roots to open the watcher stockade.
definition.failureText: Oren or Liora is lost on the burned road. The seed never reaches the Elderheart.

objectives.text: Escort convoy through all 3 checkpoints. Keep troops within seven tiles so the convoy advances.
Keep Liora Ashwing alive until the convoy arrives.

definition.title: A Door of Briars
definition.briefing: Liora attacks the stockade while the grove evacuates. Two Thunderlocks cover the central path. Use doubles to draw their volleys, keep Thornblades alive, and destroy both guns with the fixed party.
definition.successText: The stockade opens without a siege. The grove families escape, and Liora reaches the burning commander from his own supply path.
definition.failureText: Liora or every Thornblade is lost at the stockade. Reset and send the doubles before the living troops.

objectives.text: Destroy both marked guns after conjuring at least one set of Veil Doubles.
Keep Liora Ashwing alive. The army and zero-resource budget are fixed; reset restores this starting position.

definition.title: The Ash Marshal
definition.briefing: Marshal Brakka has trapped the grove wards in an ash clearing. Conjure the Veilweaver's doubles to divide his attacks, leave the warning circles, and bring down the marshal before he burns the final ward.
definition.successText: The wards return to the living seed. Liora lets the forest reclaim the watch road, and Oren plants a new grove at its gate.
definition.failureText: Liora falls and Brakka keeps the captured wards. Begin the final assault again.

objectives.text: Defeat Marshal Brakka. Survive all three phases and move out of a warning circle or interrupt it with concentrated fire.
Dodge or interrupt at least one telegraphed attack.
